name: Audit Trail
description: Tamper-evident (HMAC-chained) audit trail: a canonical event() write API, a chained PSR-3 logger any module reaches via 'chain: TRUE', audit-shaped indexed storage, an admin viewer with side-by-side before/after diff, a chain integrity verifier, secret rotation, and a cron retention lifecycle with NDJSON archiving.
project_description: Tamper-evident database logging for Drupal 11.3+ and 12. Each chained entry embeds a public SHA-256 hash of its own payload plus the hash of the previous entry in the same chain, and an operator HMAC signs that hash; inserting, editing or deleting a row after the fact breaks the chain at every downstream entry and the AuditTrailVerifier pinpoints the first broken range in a single walk. It plugs into Drupal's PSR-3 logger pipeline (any \Drupal::logger($channel) call can land in a chain via 'chain: TRUE' in context, or via a chain whose mode is 'auto'), and adds a structured AuditTrail::event() write API that bypasses the PSR-3 round-trip. Rows carry two separately-retained context tiers: a permanent (operator-attested, PII-free) bucket signed raw, and a transient bucket signed by hash so its bytes can be NULLed at a short GDPR retention window without breaking verification. HMAC secrets are audit_trail_secret config entities backed by drupal/key, so byte material stays out of config exports and DB dumps and one chain can span rotations. A five-stage cron lifecycle (transient-purge, archive to NDJSON, live-purge, file-purge, compaction) with per-chain overrides keeps purged ranges verifiable via segment attestations. Bundled submodules bridge entity CRUD, paragraph ancestry, managed-file activity, user-authentication events, and RFC-3161 TSA timestamping into the chain.
